_meta.description: Colleagues who follow a ticket or a lead get its updates (change notify-the-followers-of-tickets-and-leads). Adds OpenRegister's {"watchers": true} recipient block to ticket.ticketUpdated, lead.leadUpdated, lead.leadWon and lead.leadLost. The create rules (newTicket, newLead) get none: nobody can follow an object before it exists. Fragments replace lists rather than merge them, so each recipient list is restated in full: a later change to the assignee or group recipients of these four rules must edit this file too, or this file wins and that change is lost.
